gloss: to avoid; to evade; to avert

definitions.gloss: to avoid; to evade; to avert; to circumvent
definitions.explanation: To take action to prevent an undesirable outcome or to stay away from a dangerous or problematic situation. Used for both physical and abstract avoidance.

examples.japanese: {危険|きけん}を{回避|かいひ}する。
{渋滞|じゅうたい}を{回避|かいひ}するために{別|べつ}の{道|みち}を{通|とお}った。
examples.english: I took a different road to avoid the traffic jam.

examples.japanese: {早|はや}めに{対策|たいさく}を{取|と}ったおかげで、{最悪|さいあく}の{事態|じたい}を{回避|かいひ}することができた。
examples.english: Thanks to taking measures early, we were able to avert the worst-case scenario.

notes:
USAGE:
A relatively formal word often used in news, business, and official contexts. In casual speech, {避|さ}ける (to avoid) is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {危険|きけん}を{回避|かいひ}する (to avoid danger)
- {事故|じこ}を{回避|かいひ}する (to avert an accident)
- {リスク}を{回避|かいひ}する (to avoid risk)
- {衝突|しょうとつ}を{回避|かいひ}する (to avoid a collision)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {避|さ}ける: to avoid — more casual and broadly used, while {回避|かいひ}する implies strategic or deliberate avoidance
